description:
A persona's face and image library. list_faces: the stock faces to pick an avatar from (id, url, description). list_images / add_image (reads a local file) / update_image / remove_image: the library images used for the per-video image selection.
Actions and their required fields: list_faces (no required fields); list_images (persona); add_image (persona, path); update_image (id); remove_image (id).

action.description: What to do: list_faces | list_images | add_image | update_image | remove_image. The description lists the fields each action needs.

description.description: Description of the photo for tag/keyword matching (e.g. smiling at the beach at sunset)

id.description: The library image ID to update

isPrimary.description: Set true to mark this image as the primary library image (false is rejected — a new image is not primary unless marked)

path.description: Local file path to the image (JPG/JPEG, PNG, or WebP, max 10MB)

persona.description: The persona, by name or id (personas list shows both).

tag.description: Short tag for deterministic per-video matching (e.g. casual, formal, gym)

name: persona_media
